client_alerts.headline: Browser-based AI agents can be hijacked: BragJack hits Perplexity Comet, and the ChatGPT Lockdown Mode bypass is now public
client_alerts.body: The Hacker News reported BragJack, which hijacks AI agents that run inside a browser; Perplexity Comet is named. Check Point also published a zero-click way around ChatGPT Lockdown Mode in the desktop app: HTML previews in code blocks escaped their sandbox and could pull chat data out. OpenAI fixed it on Sept 18, and no in-the-wild use is reported. **Action:** tell clients that agentic browsers do not belong on endpoints that handle recovery runbooks or customer data. Confirm ChatGPT desktop clients are current, and do not treat Lockdown Mode alone as a data-loss control.

client_alerts.headline: GitHub Copilot CLI and Grok exposed to local file reads through hidden web-page instructions
client_alerts.body: Researchers described 'Cryptographic Context Injection', where hidden instructions on a web page get a CLI agent to read local files. Patch status is not yet confirmed. **Action:** clients running Copilot CLI on build or DR-automation hosts should limit which directories it can read and keep it off machines that hold credentials until a fix is confirmed.

top_moves.title: OpenAI gates GPT-6 Cyber to vetted red teams after its model finds 948 Linux privilege-escalation bugs
top_moves.body: GPT-6 Cyber is rated 'Critical' for cyber capability and goes first only to selected 'Daybreak Red' organizations. OpenAI says one pipeline run found, validated and patched 948 Linux kernel privilege-escalation bugs for about $1.21M in API credits, roughly $1,279 per flaw. That figure is OpenAI's own and has not been checked independently. **Patch cadence assumptions in DR plans now look optimistic.**

top_moves.title: Agent security week: ChatGPT Lockdown Mode bypass disclosed, BragJack hijacks Comet, Copilot CLI reads local files
top_moves.body: Three separate disclosures in one day all go after the same weak point: AI agents that browse the web and can act on what they find. The Lockdown fix shipped Sept 18. Patch status for BragJack and the CLI injection flaw is still unclear.

top_moves.title: Always-on work agents arrive: Perplexity Teammates and Mistral Studio Managed Agents, with Mistral on-prem due late November
top_moves.body: Perplexity launched Teammates, persistent work agents, for Max subscribers on the web. This is its first material ship in 37 days. Mistral Studio put Apps and Managed Agents into public preview, with private-cloud and on-prem deployment due late November. That is the option regulated clients care about.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.headline: GPT-6 Cyber goes to vetted red teams, and OpenAI claims 948 Linux privilege-escalation bugs found in one run.
providers.detail: GPT-6 Cyber is rated 'Critical' for cyber capability and restricted to 'Daybreak Red' organizations. ChatGPT Images 2.6 shipped Nov 4 with native animated GIFs and persistent reference images; the API models are 'Flare' (faster) and 'Sunburst' (higher quality). OpenAI hired Claude Code product lead Cat Wu from Anthropic. Check Point disclosed a Lockdown Mode bypass in the desktop app, which OpenAI fixed Sept 18.
providers.alertReason: Lockdown Mode bypass (fixed Sept 18) allowed zero-click chat exfiltration in the desktop app.

providers.name: Anthropic
providers.headline: METR finds Anthropic's capability progress running at about twice last year's pace; Personal Finance beta launches through Plaid.
providers.detail: METR's Nov 5 assessment covers Aug 12 to Oct 29 and puts most of the speed-up down to AI helping staff, not running whole projects. Most of its detail is redacted. A Personal Finance beta for US Pro, Max and Ultra plans connects accounts read-only through Plaid, covers up to two years of transactions, and keeps those chats out of training. Anthropic reportedly licensed AP election data, per anonymous sources. Its Claude Code product lead left for OpenAI.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.headline: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash extends clips to 15 seconds and cuts 720p video pricing 30%.
providers.detail: Clips go from 10 to 15 seconds, and 720p video drops to $0.07 per second. Google also committed $17B to a Wyoming data center, partly powered by a planned 702 MW fuel-cell project, and agreed to credit-backstop about $19B of Anthropic lease commitments at TeraWulf's Kentucky campus.

providers.name: xAI
providers.headline: Still no Grok 5. Grok is named in a context-injection flaw report, but the details are unverified.
providers.detail: No release. The Oct 31 Grok 5 market date passed with nothing shipped, and Grok 4.7 remains the flagship. A Hacker News report lists Grok next to GitHub Copilot CLI as affected by 'Cryptographic Context Injection', but the product naming could not be verified, so treat it as a watch item for now.

providers.name: Meta
providers.headline: Muse adds real-time expressive avatars in the US, and a proof of concept shows dictation traffic can be redirected.
providers.detail: Real-time avatars are rolling out on mobile, web and Mac. A proof of concept called 'not-a-mused' shows a local process without admin rights can redirect Muse dictation traffic. Still no new Llama weights.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.headline: Mistral Studio adds Managed Agents and enterprise Apps in public preview, with private-cloud and on-prem due late November.
providers.detail: This follows the Large 4 open-weights release. Managed Agents plus on-prem deployment make Mistral the most direct sovereign or air-gapped agent option for regulated clients. Check whether on-prem actually ships in late November before putting it in any proposal.

providers.name: Perplexity
providers.headline: Teammates launches always-on work agents for Max subscribers, while BragJack shows Comet's agent can be hijacked.
providers.detail: This is Perplexity's first material ship in 37 days. Teammates are persistent agents on the web, Max tier only for now. The same day, BragJack research showed browser AI agents, Comet included, can be hijacked. Keep Comet off client-data endpoints.
providers.alertReason: BragJack browser-agent hijack affects Perplexity Comet.

providers.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
providers.headline: No Copilot ship. Microsoft declined an option to more than double its Nscale Texas AI capacity contract.
providers.detail: The Financial Times reports Microsoft passed on expanding the Nscale deal, which is worth tens of billions. No new M365 Copilot feature found. The Copilot button rollout in Word, Excel and PowerPoint continues through December.

providers.name: GitHub Copilot
providers.headline: Copilot CLI is named in a 'Cryptographic Context Injection' flaw that lets a web page read local files.
providers.detail: This adds to the earlier EMBRACE built-in-browser flaws, which were fixed in 1.1.29. Patch status for the CLI issue is not confirmed. Limit the CLI's file scope on build and automation hosts.
providers.alertReason: Copilot CLI context-injection flaw allows local file reads; patch status unconfirmed.

providers.name: Cursor
providers.headline: The Cursor cloud agent now builds and deploys live web apps, with security checks and user approval.
providers.detail: Available on paid plans with cloud agents enabled. Treat it as a deploy path that sits outside the client's normal change management and get it under change control.

providers.name: Gamma
providers.headline: Quiet. No update found.
providers.detail: No new Gamma release surfaced in today's searches.

providers.name: Notion AI
providers.headline: Quiet. No new ship found.
providers.detail: No new Notion AI release surfaced today. A test of AI editing pages directly is still unconfirmed.
